page.overview:
Who is Aetheon?

is a feral angel of Tansul. As an NPC, he is played by Brennan Lee Mulligan.

Aetheon, as a captive, was 30 feet tall with claws and several rows of teeth like a shark, although not pointed. His body was shining and his bodily fluids glowed. His wings were plucked, and his face was ravaged by pain and misery.

Aetheon was the servant of Tansul, one of the Shapers and god of the sun; his task was to look after the Halovar family, the House of Flame in the Obridimian Empire. When Tansul was slain, Aetheon, like other celestials, went feral. Eventually he was captured by the Halovars, being secretly turned into the base of their new religion, the Candescent Creed, and the source of their Filament..}}

Aetheon has spent decades imprisoned, tortured, and mad. His existence was revealed to his younger grandson, Wicander Halovar, after he started making questions about the Light, and the Photarch used the feral angel to help him understand the true nature of their faith. During the conversation, Aetheon was constantly making tortured noises, trying to move and attack those outside the Prismatic Retort.
